description: Capture the frontmost app's UI as a numbered list of elements: e12 is label 12 for Click, Type, Scroll and Move. Params: use_vision (add a screenshot), use_annotation (draw the labels on it), app (another app). Call it first and after the UI changes.

app.description: App name or bundle id (default: the frontmost app).

use_annotation.description: With use_vision: draw the labels on the image.

use_dom.description: Ignored: web content is in the accessibility tree.

use_ui_tree.description: Ignored: the element list is always returned.

use_vision.description: Include a screenshot of the window.

name: Snapshot
title: Snapshot an app's UI

description: Capture a display (display=[index]) or a region ([left, top, right, bottom] in screen points) as an image. Coordinates on macOS are points; the result gives the scale.

use_annotation.description: Ignored (use Snapshot with use_vision for labels).

name: Screenshot
title: Take a screenshot

description:
Map an app in one call: its windows, menu bar (top-level menus with item counts), toolbar buttons,
tabs, sidebar sections, scroll areas, open dialogs and the focused element, plus how well AXPilot can
drive it (app kind, accessibility quality, strategies, tips).
Call it first for an unfamiliar app, then snapshot for the full element list. Params: app / window_id.
Returns a compact overview with refs (usable with click, read, scroll…) and the snapshot_id they belong
to. Errors: APP_NOT_FOUND, WINDOW_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_ACCESSIBILITY, BLOCKED_BY_POLICY, TIMEOUT.

app.description: Target app: name ('Notes'), bundle id ('com.apple.Notes') or pid. Default: the frontmost app.

window_id.description: Window id from list_windows; scopes the call to that window.

name: Explore
title: Explore an app

description: Wait (polling) until text_exists, active_window, element_exists, element_enabled or focused_element holds for text / window_name in the frontmost app, up to timeout seconds (at most 60).

interval.description: Ignored: AXPilot chooses the polling interval.

text.description: Text, element name or window title.

use_dom.description: Ignored: web content is in the accessibility tree.

name: WaitFor
title: Wait for a condition

description:
Report AXPilot's state: version, engine, macOS version, permissions (Accessibility, Screen
Recording), whether the user paused it (kill switch), the input lock, the active profile and
enabled tools, rate limit and confirmation mode.
Use it first when tools fail with permission errors, or to check what this server can do.
name: ControlStatus
title: AXPilot status

description: Click an element (label) or a point (loc). label is the number of a snapshot ref (12 for e12); loc is [x, y] in macOS screen points. button left|right|middle; clicks 1-3. Returns what changed.

label.description: Element label: the number of a snapshot ref (12 for e12).

loc.description: [x, y] in macOS screen points (from a snapshot).

name: Click
title: Click

description: Select several items (files, rows, checkboxes): clicks each of locs ([[x, y], …]) or labels ([12, 13, …]) while holding cmd (press_ctrl=true), or plain clicks (press_ctrl=false).

press_ctrl.description: Hold cmd to add each item to the selection.

name: MultiSelect
title: Click

description: Type text into a field (label or loc; default: the focused field). label is the number of a snapshot ref (12 for e12); loc is [x, y] in macOS screen points. clear replaces the text; caret_position start|end moves the caret first; press_enter presses Return.

caret_position.description: Move the caret to the start or end first (idle: leave it).

label.description: Element label: the number of a snapshot ref (12 for e12).

loc.description: [x, y] in macOS screen points (from a snapshot).

name: Type
title: Type text

description: Press keys: "cmd+c", "cmd+shift+t", "return", or several separated by spaces ("cmd+a delete"). macOS shortcuts use cmd where Windows uses ctrl; win means cmd.

shortcut.description: Keys joined by +, e.g. "cmd+c" (cmd, not ctrl); several: separate by spaces.

name: Shortcut
title: Press keys

description: Scroll at a label, a loc or the pointer. label is the number of a snapshot ref (12 for e12); loc is [x, y] in macOS screen points. direction up|down|left|right (type horizontal turns up/down into left/right); wheel_times notches of 3 lines.

label.description: Element label: the number of a snapshot ref (12 for e12).

loc.description: [x, y] in macOS screen points (from a snapshot).

name: Scroll
title: Scroll

description: Launch (name: app name, bundle id or .app path), switch to (bring to front) or resize apps. resize moves/resizes the app's front window to window_loc [x, y] / window_size [w, h] (screen points); launch takes them too. launch_executable opens an .app path (no args or cwd on macOS).

name.description: App name, bundle id or .app path.

window_loc.description: [x, y] for the window's top-left corner.

name: App
title: Manage an app
